title: Komorebi
description: Lying under the stone pines of a Roman piazza, looking up into the crown overhead, where the sun is a star through the needles. The pointer is a breath of wind: the crowns sway on their own springs, near ones slow and wide, far ones quick and small, layered by depth so they slide past each other, and the tuft over the sun swings clear, so the needles part across the disc and the sun blooms through on the film, glinting along their edges, before they close again. At rest a breeze rolls through.
intent: Summer-film genre: komorebi (sunlight filtering through leaves) seen from directly below a canopy, after herb's worm's-eye references (factory/reality/herb-refs/2-wormseye-skyscrapers.png, 3-lightpole-cumulus.png): deep cyan-cobalt sky, extreme upward perspective, soft film colour. Reference: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Komorebi and https://polyhaven.com/a/piazza_martin_lutero

sources.author: Greg Zaal (HDRI), Rico Cilliers (backplates)
sources.note: 16K linear HDRI, reprojected offline to a stereographic view (yaw 36, pitch 64 up, 140 degrees), lens veil and diffraction spikes removed, sky rebuilt, trees split into three depth layers with Depth Anything V2. Sun measured at azimuth 35.9, altitude 24.2; drawn higher, behind the heart of the overhead crown on clear sky, under one tuft of needles on its own spring that a gust swings off the disc. Sky regraded in the shader to a Superia cobalt, pale at the horizon and deepening overhead.

sources.author: Greg Zaal (original), Jarod Guest (sky edits)
sources.note: The cumulus. 8K linear puresky HDRI, reprojected to the same stereographic upward view and turned so its sun lands exactly on the drawn sun (tilted 24 degrees down, rolled 15 degrees about the sun axis), so every cloud is lit from where the sun is drawn. Clouds unmixed from their clear sky by blue excess, relit to the scene's sun and skylight, highlights rolled off below the film's clip, composited behind the needle mattes; in the shader the shade takes the skylight, the sunlit tops roll off to cream and local contrast is lifted by the sun.
